title: Runway Ops Field Desk — expense handoff & vendor contacts
content:
Quick purpose: compact field-desk cheat + expense handoff notes for booth teams, temporary staff, and vendor liaisons. Keep short — save to receipts drive folder after event.

TOPLINE PROCESS (2-min read)
- Capture receipts in phone (camera + filename rule) within 24h.
  - Filename format: redwood-YYYYMMDD-VENDOR-amount (e.g. redwood-20250922-parkercafe-18.34).
  - Upload to: Shared drive > events > 2025-09-runway-summit > receipts > incoming.
- Card vs cash: if company card used, tag transaction in Expensify and note attendee initials in memo. If cash, add photo of receipt + handoff form (see below).
- Handoff: daily closeout at 8pm local to field-desk lead (Omar). Digital tally + physical receipts in envelope labeled with day and booth number.
- Reimbursement SLA: submit to Finance within 72h of event end for standard processing (4–6 business days typical). Expedited with reason code "press" or "vendor-fee".

CONTACTS (phone-first)
- Field-desk lead: Omar Ruiz — +1 (415) 555-0128 (WhatsApp enabled).
- Vendor liaison (AV): Leah Park — +1 (650) 555-0199 (on-site after 6/23).
- Logistics partner (crate/drayage): CrateFast ops — ops@cratefast.co / +1 (646) 555-0101 (ask for Miguel).
- Hotel billing disputes: Front Desk — Hilton Runway — +1 (408) 555-0212 — reference: Redwood Invoicing (acct 8721).
- Emergency on-site security: Venue Security Dispatch — +1 (408) 555-0000 (use badge color "red" protocol).

RECEIPT PHOTO GUIDELINES (very short)
- Ensure vendor name and total are legible.
- If printed receipt clipped to card slip, photograph whole stack and single receipt separately.
- For hand-written taxi receipts: add short note in photo caption with time and driver name.

CASH HANDOFF FORM (one-line template to copy)
- "Date, Booth #, Staff initials, Amount, Purpose, Vendor name, Notes, Handed to (name)"
- Example: "2025-09-22, Booth 14, MK, $120.00, Dinner w/ partner, Parker Cafe, handoff to Omar"

CARD USE & TAX-EXEMPT/INVOICE REQUESTS
- Corporate card is preferred for supplies, AV surcharges, and air travel. For any invoice request, insist on a PDF invoice with VAT/Tax ID and remit-to address: billing@redwood.com.
- If vendor tries to charge a service fee, capture the policy screenshot and escalate to Leah.

ON-SITE OPS CHECKLIST (for new temps)
- Field-desk tablet charged & hotspot tested (SSID: Redwood-Field-2025).
- Printer (thermal label) stocked + spare paper roll.
- Spare pens, zip ties, masking tape, multi-tool, small first-aid kit.
- Badge printer preloaded with event badge list (pull from Confluence roster link).

FAQ & EDGE CASES (notes-to-self)
- Lost receipt: require staff attestation (signed) + card statement showing amount if card used. Finance accepts attestation only for amounts < $75; escalate otherwise.
- Split tabs: capture itemized receipt where possible. If only one receipt exists, have paying staff write names and amounts on handoff form and initial.
- Vendor overcharge dispute: take photo of posted rates/menu and receipt; escalate immediately to vendor liaison and cc ops@redwood.com.

PROMPT ACTIONS (T minus timeline)
- T-3 days: preload expense templates into phone notes, confirm field-desk tablet hotspot, confirm printer label stock.
- Day 0 (setup): collect vendor contact cards, confirm crate arrival window, verify AV package + estimate signed.
- Daily during event: 1800h — closeout, tally, upload receipts to receipts/incoming, digitize cash handoff forms.
- Post-event (24–72h): run reconciliation, send one consolidated folder link to finance with CSV tally and scanned receipts.

OPEN QUESTIONS (log here so we can iterate)
- Can Finance accept receipts uploaded to vendor portal (CrateFast) for drayage or do we need PDF emailed directly? (ask Finance SME: Priya)
- Should we include an expense category code in filename? Pros: easier parsing. Cons: more manual for staff. (test at next event)

SHORT TODO (assign and tick)
- [ ] Create one-click phone note template (.txt) for new temps — OWNER: Maya (due 2025-10-01).
- [ ] Confirm expedited reimbursement criteria with Finance (Priya) — OWNER: Omar (due 2025-09-25).
- [ ] Add hotel billing dispute template email to linked_artifacts — OWNER: Leah (due 2025-09-26).

LINKS & REFERENCES (save-to-confluence later)
- Confluence: Event Runway 2025 (ops checklist) — put final folder link here after event.
- Finance policy: expensing and attestation (internal doc).
- Template: cash-handoff-form (Google Sheet) — create under receipts > templates.

FINAL NOTES (voice-of-the-staff)
- Keep the process frictionless for booth staff. If it delays demos or partner meetings, capture reason and waive small procedural steps if approved by Omar. We care more about partner experience than the perfect receipt name.

Raw scratch: airport lounge passes sometimes charged to booth; mark as "amenity" and flag if > $50.

— Maya
